title: PJ Half Marathon 2026 Review: Petaling Jaya's City-Centre 21K
seo_title: PJ Half Marathon 2026 Review | Selangor Malaysia Race
meta_description: PJ Half Marathon 2026: September 6 at Laman MBPJ, Petaling Jaya. A single-distance 21.1K in KL's satellite city — registration open.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 at Laman MBPJ in Petaling Jaya, Selangor — KL's largest satellite city — this single-distance half marathon has registration open.
verdict: The PJ Half Marathon is a focused, single-distance 21.1K in Petaling Jaya — Kuala Lumpur's largest satellite city and a major commercial hub in its own right. Anchored at Laman MBPJ (the city council square), the race benefits from PJ's wide roads and the city's large running community. Registration is open. A straightforward, accessible Klang Valley half marathon for local runners.

sections.heading: PJ: KL's Satellite City
paragraphs: Petaling Jaya is the Klang Valley's largest satellite city with a strong running community and wide roads that support a good half marathon course. [1] Laman MBPJ provides a central, accessible race hub. Registration is open.
